name: Bjarke Berg
quote: Warren has a unique ability to provide valuable input regarding the user/developer experience of new features and framework code. He has always been able to demonstrate and present these features in a convincing way in his HackMakeDo videos.

He also displayed great skills in implementing various functions and small tools to help other developers. Especially his extensions for VS Code and Windows applications to read Umbraco logs have been useful to countless of people.
I gladly recommend Warren as a software developer and developer advocate. His ability to create a positive user/developer experience and communicate complex ideas is remarkable.
